يستخلبون (form X)
# يَسْتَخْلِبُونَ (yastaḵlibūna) /jas.tax.li.buː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَخْلَبَ (istaḵlaba)
# يُسْتَخْلَبُونَ (yustaḵlabūna) /jus.tax.la.buː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَخْلَبَ (istaḵlaba)
